WITH per_synset AS (
  SELECT s.wordid AS wordid, s.synsetid AS synsetid, COUNT(*) AS sense_count
  FROM senses s
  GROUP BY s.wordid, s.synsetid
),
word_agg AS (
  SELECT p.wordid AS wordid,
         COUNT(*) AS total_synsets,
         SUM(p.sense_count) AS total_senses,
         COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) AS distinct_domains,
         COUNT(DISTINCT syn.posid) AS distinct_posids
  FROM per_synset p
  JOIN synsets syn ON syn.synsetid = p.synsetid
  GROUP BY p.wordid
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
     AND COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) >= 2
     AND SUM(p.sense_count) >= 2
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT p.wordid AS wordid,
         p.synsetid AS synsetid,
         p.sense_count AS sense_count,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY p.wordid
           ORDER BY p.sense_count DESC, p.synsetid ASC
         ) AS rn
  FROM per_synset p
)
SELECT w.wordid AS word_id,
       w.word AS word,
       a.total_synsets,
       a.total_senses,
       a.distinct_domains,
       a.distinct_posids,
       r.synsetid AS top_synsetid,
       r.sense_count AS top_synset_sense_count
FROM word_agg a
JOIN words w ON w.wordid = a.wordid
JOIN ranked r ON r.wordid = a.wordid AND r.rn = 1
ORDER BY a.total_senses DESC,
         a.total_synsets DESC,
         a.distinct_domains DESC,
         w.wordid ASC
LIMIT 500;
